decisions.title: Good Company uses horizontal grouped review motion
decisions.text: Live inspection of amberwalkerevents.com showed that reviews advance horizontally as complete three-card groups with a pause between transitions; the logo rail also moves horizontally at roughly 50 pixels per second. This supersedes the initial vertical-scroll hypothesis in the UI-POLISH-R5 wording.

knowledge.title: R5 Vercel deployment verified
knowledge.text: Commit d611b0c4553fbfe6c32fa47a753ed15b329c4c31 deployed successfully to https://amber-walker-events-clone.vercel.app. The homepage, /blog, and /torontoproposalplanning each returned HTTP 200 after the deployment reached Ready.
knowledge.source: Vercel deployment dpl_9DAVKY9wQMchVccSkU9uenvuv9Ss and direct HTTP checks

knowledge.title: Vercel image outage caused by disabled Git LFS
knowledge.text: The first Vercel build served 129-132 byte Git LFS pointer files from public/media because the linked project had gitLFS disabled. Enabling gitLFS and redeploying production as dpl_D57ZRDCirb8x4kZq1MWHnEuxmHPj restored real media. Post-deploy checks found zero failures across 67 homepage, 15 blog, and 28 representative location image requests.
knowledge.source: Vercel project configuration and live HTTP checks on 2026-09-28
